$comment: Committed brand configuration: shared hooks run from the brand root through run-hook.py. The permission rules protect the pinned method mount. The git guard keeps git off the brand repo, because the Parker Desktop app syncs this folder (see /save-brain). Parker is the shared voice. Personal overrides belong in settings.local.json. Keep shared hook behavior aligned with .codex/config.toml; see parker-system/system/codex-support.md.

hooks.command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; import subprocess, runpy; r = subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', '--show-toplevel'], capture_output=True, text=True); p = Path(r.stdout.strip()) / '.claude/hooks/run-hook.py'; runpy.run_path(str(p), run_name='__main__') if r.returncode == 0 and p.is_file() else None" git-guard
